name: European long distance path E8 - part Ireland
description_md:
The European long distance path E8 in Ireland is a waymarked hiking route that spans 605.7 km. This international network trail is signposted as E8 and is classified as hard due to the distance and 14477 m of ascent.

The route involves 14509 m of descent and requires about 190 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It passes Aviva Stadium within 200 m, the Battle of Clontarf within 1400 m, and Leinster House within 1700 m.
